note: A non-randomised 12-month intervention (n = 168) with 3 g/day of ALA from flaxseed oil for 9 months, across Western, flexitarian, vegetarian and vegan diets.

excerpts.anchor: In Western diet participants, erythrocyte n-6 PUFA increased by 5.5%
excerpts.until: In conclusion, flaxseed oil supplementation combined
marks: DHA (+12.8–26.0%) increased significantly across all dietary patterns
Conversion efficiency was unaffected by sex, BMI, age, linoleic acid, or arachidonic acid
